gap: No result ChatGPT got states that YesWelder's own store sells the TIG-200P ACDC PRO with its FP-5P-B foot pedal for $599.15, which is less than the $649.00 bare machine ChatGPT showed (and warned 'foot pedal may cost extra'). That makes it the cheapest AC/DC, pedal-included machine we could confirm on a maker store today, $130.84 under ARCCAPTAIN's TIG200P pedal kit ($729.99).
standout_why: Checked against the two cited pages. homewelder.com (cited, 2026-10-11) lists the YesWelder at $649 and says the pedal is 'sold separately (variant includes it)', but never prices that variant or adds up pedal-included costs. It gives ARCCAPTAIN only as 'Under $700'. woodworking-projects.com/hobby-tig-welder (cited) gives only price ranges, no pedal prices and no warranty lengths. ChatGPT's own answers priced the YesWelder bare at $649 and the PrimeWeld at either '$800–$1,000' or '$999'. None of them prices every candidate with a pedal from the maker's store.
decides: If 'cheap' means a working aluminum setup with a pedal, the YesWelder TIG-200P ACDC PRO + pedal at $599.15 is the cheapest AC/DC pick we could confirm on a maker store today. It beats the ARCCAPTAIN TIG200P pedal kit ($729.99) on price and on 110V output (140 A vs 120 A). PrimeWeld's TIG225X lists at $849 but showed as unavailable. LOTOS's $399.98 could not be checked on a maker page, so it can't be the sourced pick. Our current page's 'Under $729.99 with pedal' for the YesWelder is wrong and should be $599.15.
